description: Debian 13 "Trixie" with the GNOME desktop. The universal operating system: legendary stability, a vast package archive, and a volunteer project that has been the bedrock of the Linux world for three decades. Installed offline from the live image, so no network is needed until first boot.

maintainer.note: debian-installer + live-installer plugin: installs offline from the Debian Live image (copies the squashfs), the casper-style path shared with the Linux Mint plugin. RAM minimum is 4 GiB because the ~3.5 GB Live ISO is copied into RAM (iso-scan/copy_iso_to_ram) so the same disk can be repartitioned.
